verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair ask for a developer API, so the axis applies. The pack shows a Zoom-wide developer-portal llms.txt linking a portal-level API catalog, and the Scribe docs list REST endpoints only as prose; nothing evidences a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec covering the Scribe API itself. A portal-wide catalog is a related surface, not the product’s own machine spec, so no credit attaches (corrected 2026-11-01 per the prompt-v5 own-capability rule; PR #563 review).
